shortDescription: Australia’s Treasurer Jim Chalmers warned the economy faces “serious risks” as the population ages and grows more slowly, according to Bloomberg.He said the demographic shift will also pressure government finances.

title: Australia Treasurer Flags Economic Risks From Aging Population
